title: A retry interval of zero and a negative stopping interval have different outcomes
summary: The asynchronous retry scheduled the zero-delay attempt and stopped on a negative exceptional interval. With a retryable result, it announced a negative-delay retry even though the supplier ran only once.

change.description: Asynchronous retry schedules another call for a zero delay. For exceptional outcomes, the retry context reports a negative delay as a terminal error event.

notes: The exceptional path branches on the sign before event publication. AsyncContext.onResult publishes RetryOnRetryEvent before returning its interval, and the async decorator stops at a negative value.

The caller ran on Resilience4j 2.1.0, 2.2.0. A negative interval for a retryable result ended the stage after one call on both releases. Only 2.2.0 emitted the −1 ms retry event. Both original PR pins also emitted it.
